title: К портрету Чаадаева
author: Александр Пушкин
translation: By the supreme will of heaven he was born in the shackles of tsarist service; in Rome he would have been Brutus, in Athens Pericles,

title: К портрету Чаадаева
author: Александр Пушкин
translation: But here he is an officer of the hussars.
